declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseCarry
declarations.contract: def phaseCarry (c : Nat) : Nat := if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseDigit
declarations.contract: def phaseDigit (c : Nat) : Nat := c - 9 * phaseCarry c

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow
declarations.contract:
def overflow (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) : Nat :=
  (normalize B.reverse (phaseCarry c)).2

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseCarry_le_one
declarations.contract: theorem phaseCarry_le_one (c : Nat) : phaseCarry c ≤ 1

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseCarry_eq_div_nine
declarations.contract:
theorem phaseCarry_eq_div_nine (c : Nat) (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) :
    phaseCarry c = c / 9

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseDigit_identity
declarations.contract:
theorem phaseDigit_identity (c : Nat) :
    9 * phaseCarry c + phaseDigit c = c

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseDigit_le_eight
declarations.contract:
theorem phaseDigit_le_eight (c : Nat) (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) :
    phaseDigit c ≤ 8

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.phaseDigit_pos
declarations.contract:
theorem phaseDigit_pos (c : Nat) (hc0 : 0 < c) :
    0 < phaseDigit c

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow_eq_highValue
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_eq_highValue (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) :
    overflow c B = (highValue B + phaseCarry c) / 10 ^ B.length

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow_eq_rho_quotient
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_eq_rho_quotient (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) :
    overflow c B = rhoNum c B / (9 * 10 ^ B.length)

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow_le_one
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_le_one (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) : overflow c B ≤ 1

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow_eq_zero_iff
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_eq_zero_iff (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) :
    overflow c B = 0 ↔ rhoNum c B < 9 * 10 ^ B.length

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.overflow_eq_one_iff
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_eq_one_iff (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    overflow c B = 1 ↔ 9 * 10 ^ B.length ≤ rhoNum c B

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.rhoNum_lt_twice_denominator
declarations.contract:
theorem rhoNum_lt_twice_denominator (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hc : c ≤ 17) (hc9 : c ≠ 9) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    rhoNum c B < 18 * 10 ^ B.length

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.empty_word_coordinates
declarations.contract:
theorem empty_word_coordinates (c : Nat) :
    overflow c [] = phaseCarry c ∧ rhoNum c [] = c

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.empty_word_quotient_iff
declarations.contract:
theorem empty_word_quotient_iff (c : Nat) :
    (overflow c [] = rhoNum c [] / (9 * 10 ^ ([] : List Nat).length)) ↔
      c ≤ 17 ∧ c ≠ 9

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.quotient_identity_forall_iff
declarations.contract:
theorem quotient_identity_forall_iff (c : Nat) :
    (∀ B : List Nat, overflow c B = rhoNum c B / (9 * 10 ^ B.length)) ↔
      c ≤ 17 ∧ c ≠ 9

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.excluded_phase_controls
declarations.contract:
theorem excluded_phase_controls :
    overflow 9 [] = 0 ∧ rhoNum 9 [] / (9 * 10 ^ ([] : List Nat).length) = 1 ∧
    overflow 18 [] = 1 ∧ rhoNum 18 [] / (9 * 10 ^ ([] : List Nat).length) = 2

declarations.name: Agent6.ExteriorCoordinates.unbounded_coefficient_control
declarations.contract:
theorem unbounded_coefficient_control :
    overflow 0 [20] = 2 ∧ 9 * 10 ^ ([20] : List Nat).length ≤ rhoNum 0 [20]

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.nonneutralPhase_coordinate_bounds
declarations.contract:
theorem nonneutralPhase_coordinate_bounds (c : Nat) (hc : nonneutralPhase c) :
    c ≤ 17 ∧ c ≠ 9

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.overflow_eq_coordinate_selector
declarations.contract:
theorem overflow_eq_coordinate_selector (c : Nat) (B : List Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    (normalize B.reverse (if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0)).2 =
      if 9 * 10 ^ B.length ≤ rhoNum c B then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.outerNext_from_coordinates
declarations.contract:
theorem outerNext_from_coordinates (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (cut : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18)
    (hcut : B.length + 1 ≤ cut) :
    outerNext { c := c, B := B } =
      { c := bulkPhase c,
        B := stripSuffix (bulkPhase c)
          (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y)
            (adicNumeratorDigits cut (zValue c B - (c : Int)))
            (fractionDigits cut (rhoNum c B)
              (9 * 10 ^ B.length *
                10 ^ (if 9 * 10 ^ B.length ≤ rhoNum c B then 1 else 0)))) }

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.outerNext_from_coordinates_quotient
declarations.contract:
theorem outerNext_from_coordinates_quotient (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (cut : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18)
    (hcut : B.length + 1 ≤ cut) :
    outerNext { c := c, B := B } =
      { c := bulkPhase c,
        B := stripSuffix (bulkPhase c)
          (List.zipWith (fun x y => x + y)
            (adicNumeratorDigits cut (zValue c B - (c : Int)))
            (fractionDigits cut (rhoNum c B)
              (9 * 10 ^ B.length *
                10 ^ (rhoNum c B / (9 * 10 ^ B.length))))) }

declarations.name: Agent5.ExactDigitStreams.fractionDigits_coordinates_digits_lt_ten
declarations.contract:
theorem fractionDigits_coordinates_digits_lt_ten (c : Nat) (B : List Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hc : nonneutralPhase c) (hB : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≤ 18) :
    ∀ x ∈ fractionDigits n (rhoNum c B)
      (9 * 10 ^ B.length *
        10 ^ (if 9 * 10 ^ B.length ≤ rhoNum c B then 1 else 0)), x < 10

unproved_scope: Exterior cycle or safe infinite orbit
